Es bedarf einer flächendeckenden Versorgung des gesamten Kreisgebietes mit einem Netz an hochleistungsfähigen Breitbandanschlüssen (Next Generation Access (NGA)-Netze). Zum Aufbau und Betrieb von hochleistungsfähigen Breitband-Netzen in den unterversorgten Gebieten wurden dem Landkreis Nordsachsen entsprechende Fördermittel vom Bund und vom Freistaat Sachsen gewährt. Fördergegenstand ist der Aufbau und der Betrieb von NGA-Netzen im sog. "Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell". Der Landkreis Nordsachsen beabsichtigt die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb von NGA-Netzen im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell zu fördern und die entsprechenden Errichtungs- und Betriebsleistungen gemäß den fördermittelrechtlichen Vorgaben auszuschreiben. Der Landkreis Nordsachsen sucht für die Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von europaweiten Ausschreibungsverfahren zur Breitbanderschließung von drei Projektgebieten im sog. Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell je einen fachlich kompetenten und wirtschaftlich zuverlässigen Dienstleister für planerisch-technische Beratungsleistungen (Los 1) sowie juristische Beratungsleistungen (Los 2). title: ADHA MASS-MEMORY MODULES AND UNIT INTEGRATION EXPRO PLUS
description: Objective:To develop a complete ADHA solid-state mass-memory with compatible modules, usable either standalone orwith other ADHA-compatible hardware in ADHA units for Earth observation, exploration, science, andnavigation missions.Description:The ADHA (Advanced Data Handling Architecture) is a collaboration between ESA, European satellite primesand data handling equipment suppliers. It includes the definition of an architecture for data handling unitsbased on standard module functions. A standard module procurementflow has been defined, as well as astandardized backplane connector and electrical interfaces. This allows independent developmentofinteroperable modules that can be connected in ADHA units.This activity aims to develop ADHA solid-state mass-memory (MM) modules, based on ADHA-compatiblehardware modules. The development will follow the standard requirements for the development of ADHAmodules.The mass-memory module design will be fully compliant to the ADHA generic specification for mass-memorymodules. The developmentwill include the development of the mass-memory software (including support forfile-based operations, and CFDP Class-1 and Class-2). The developed ADHA mass memory module willsupport high-speed data reception and transfers, featuring a scalable architecture to meet the demands offuture ESA missions in earth observation, science, exploration, and navigation, as well as commercialmissions. Utilizing state-of-the-art processing, memory storage and interconnect technologies, this new massmemoryshall offer superior integration, data storage volume and processing performance compared toprevious generations. These advancements will also enable the implementation of sophisticated functionssuch as artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) algorithms for on-board data processing.The activity encompasses the following tasks:- Detailed module requirements analysis, based on the existing ADHA specification documents, including theADHA generic mass-memory module specification.- ADHA mass memory module architectural design and trade-off of key components.- Engineering model (EM) design, including electrical, mechanical, thermal, FPGA design and software.- Engineering model (EM) manufacturing and EGSE procurement.- Engineering model (EM) validation campaign, including integration in anADHA unit rack.- Data-handling and storage demonstration, including performance benchmarks.NOTE: This activity is currently in the GSTP Work Plan but will only be implemented after confirmation of financial support from Delegations. The final list of participating states will be known at tender issue.

title: Servicii de transmisie date ce asigura suportul realizarii managementului activitatii de pescuit
description: Agenția Națională pentru Pescuit și Acvacultură a achiziționat recent noi echipamente de comunicații de tip transponder satelit și GSM, echipamente necesare pentru actualizarea componentei de comunicații ce asigură suportul realizării managementului de pescuit. Soluția are la bază echipamentele RockFLEET/YB3i – IRIDIUM DEVICES (VESSEL MONITORING SYSTEMS) produse de compania engleză Rock Seven Mobile Service Limited. Astfel, în vederea atingerii obiectivelor stabilite prin Regulamentul UE nr. 508/2014 al Parlamentului European și al Consiliului din 15 mai 2014 privind Fondul european pentru pescuit şi afaceri maritime, respectiv art. 76, Control și executare, se impune achiziționarea de noi Servicii de transmisii de date care să asigure continuitatea în transmiterea de date dinspre actorii implicați în activitățile de pescuit și de comercializare a produselor pescărești spre autoritățile relevante ale statelor membre și ale Uniuni și trasabilitatea produselor pescărești și de acvacultură. Cerinte pentru serviciile de transmisie date 1. Servicii de transmisie date VMS Se vor achizitiona servicii de transmisie a datelor VMS de la transpondere către CMP. Prin utilizarea unui format specific, datele VMS primite pot fi interpretate automat de catre CMP. Pe baza acestora CMP poate bloca/debloca accesul la datele legate de un anumit vas pentru alte tari. Aceasta informatie va fi utilizata pentru trimiterea automata a anumitor mesaje pe baza criteriilor reglementate. Cu ajutorul datelor va fi posibila vizualizarea flotei active, gestionarea zonelor de pescuit cu acces restrictionat, vizualizarea datelor privind capturile si detectarea activitatilor de pescuit nedeclarate si nereglememntate. Aceste servicii vor include minim transmiterea a 24 pozitii/zi/nava. 2. Servicii de transmisie date ERS Se vor achizitiona servicii de tip abonament. CMP existent poate prelua date atat de la transponderele existente, cat si de la altele noi ce vor fi furnizate. Datele se vor folosi pentru o supraveghere permanenta a vaselor de pescuit. Se vor putea customiza alerte pentru a sprijini activitatea de monitorizare a pescuitului. Se vor recepționa date de longitudine, latitudine, viteza si cursul urmat de o nava. Datele vor fi procesate pentru a ajuta la conservarea stocurilor de peste si de a le gestiona intr-un mod durabil economic. Vor fi transmise rapoartele de captura zilnice precum si rapoartele celorlalte operatii de pescuit (plecare, intrare in zona, debarcare, etc) in mod grupat, pe voiaje de pescuit. Aplicatia de la bordul navelor prezinta formularele de introducere de date pre-completate cu datele deja disponibile, prin utilizarea parametrilor configurabili, ale informatiilor GPS, ale datei si timpului curent. Serviciile oferite vor fi în regim 24h pe zi, 7 zile din 7. Suportul tehnic include analizarea problemelor notificate de către beneficiar precum și prioritizarea acestora după un grad de severitate. Achiziția implică încheierea unui acord cadru și se va derula începând cu data semnării lui având o durata de 24 de luni. Cantitati minime/maxime acord cadru: - minim – 68 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS; - maxim – 80 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS. Cantitati minime/maxime contract subsecvent: - minim – 68 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS; - maxim – 80 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS. Achiziţionarea produselor care fac obiectul prezentei achiziţii publice se va face fără a depăşi limita maximă a întregii cantităţi indicate în acordul cadru. title: Tactical HF radio system
description: 1 Description The purpose of this request is to get information and to seek potential technical solutions from the industry for renewing the current tactical high frequency (HF) radio system used by the Finnish Defence Forces. The tactical HF radio system is used jointly by Finnish Army, Navy, Air Force and Border Guard in several different platforms and units and it should meet the technical and operational requirements defined by each branch. The use cases and operating environments vary greatly throughout the different user organizations. The primary users are within the Army special forces. The new tactical HF radio system shall support portability in field environment, secure data and voice communications, high data rate waveforms, high speed link establishment and flexible upgradability in the future. It shall be fully integrable to Finnish Defence Forces joint tactical C2 system and branch specific systems as well. The system shall be based on wideband HF (WBHF) technology. 2 General Information Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command is conducting a market consultation by this document, Request for Information (RFI). The RFI is not a contract notice or a Request for Quotation (RFQ) initiating a procurement process. This RFI should not be construed as an obligation on the part of the Finnish Defence Forces to implement any procurement, and the decision on initiating a potential procurement process is made after the market consultation. Any and all costs relating to submitting a reply to this RFI shall be totally at the respondent’s expense and risk. This entire RFI is public. Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command wishes to emphasize the following points related to the potential procurement which are significant for the respondent: - The potential procurement will be implemented as a fixed price procurement. Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command will fund the potential procurement. - The potential procurement will start at 2025 and will include approximately 600 to 1000 units of tactical HF radios with necessary auxiliary equipment, software and training. - The potential procurement will impose requirements on security of information. The subject of the potential procurement is such that requirements on security of information need to be imposed both on the procurement process and on the implementation of the procurement contract. The potential procurement includes information which is confidential according to the Act on the Openness of Government Activities (621 / 1999) 24.1 § paragraph 10. Questions related to the RFI should be directed to the person mentioned below in clause “Contact information”. The questions should be asked in English or in Finnish and delivered by e-mail no later than 30.4.2022 at 12.00 (Finnish time). Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command will answer to the questions by delivering the collected questions and answers collectively to all recipients who have provided their contact information. The questions and answers will be delivered to the recipients by e-mail no later than 15.5.2021 at 12.00 (Finnish time). To ensure that it is possible to deliver the questions and answers to all interested respondents, Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command requests that the recipients of this RFI would name a contact person and provide his/her contact information when they have received this RFI. 3 Contact information The contact person nominated by the Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command is: Mikko Kyllönen, Project Manager FDF Logistics Command Joint Systems Centre, Army Systems Section e-mail: mikko.kyllonen@mil.fi +358 299 578 478 Commercial contact: Kai Laine The Finnish Defence Forces, Logistic Command HQ e-mail: kai.laine@mil.fi +358 299 570 430 Please note that only the persons mentioned above will answer to enquiries related to this RFI. 4 Background The tactical HF radio enables voice and data communications between network stations via line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight links. The tactical HF radio operates on a medium and high frequency bands from 1.5 to 30 megahertz (MHz) providing surface wave and sky wave propagation methods. Surface wave can reach beyond the horizon to some extent. With sky wave propagation it is possible to exploit the ionospheric reflection and thus achieve communication distances up to thousands of kilometers. Near vertical incidence skywave (NVIS) enables skip-zone free communications up to hundreds of kilometers. Due the chaotic and ever-changing nature of the ionosphere and the unstable usability of the HF frequencies in general, a high level of adaptivity in the data modem and in the automatic frequency selection or automatic link establishment (ALE) is critical in the HF radio system. This is especially important in tactical communications where fast and reliable message delivery is crucial. A system that offers only static data waveform modes and fixed frequency or slow ALE is therefore not an option in Finnish Defence Forces tactical operating environment. The operator input for the communication parameters and settings should be minimal. The tactical HF radio should support both mobile and stationary use. A need for data capacity has risen also for tactical level HF communication. Nowadays it is required to have an ability to transfer more data within shorter time frame than in the past. In practice this means ability to send and receive e-mails, images, track data or instant messages beside the traditional short and flash messages. This requires a WBHF waveform. Software-defined radio (SDR) architecture enables flexible waveform development which is required to have a future-proof HF radio system. By having an embedded SDR waveform the need for auxiliary equipment can be minimized. The Finnish tactical operating environment is challenging from several perspectives of the HF communications. The weather conditions can get hard especially during winter with extremely low temperatures, snow and ice. This sets special physical requirements for radios and accessory devices like antennas. Also, the location at northern latitudes makes the use of skywave more complex and difficult due the direction of earths geomagnetic field and sudden ionospheric disturbances. To operate effectively in this special HF environment requires sophisticated and highly adaptive HF waveform, which can react to natural or man-made changes in frequency usability automatically and fast as possible. 5 Preliminary requirements The following list defines some of the general and preliminary requirements for the tactical HF radio system. Its main purpose is to give overall idea and rough guidelines to the RFI respondent on what kind of tactical HF radio system Finnish Defence Forces is looking for.
